title: Prepositions of time and place
about: at, on, in; for, during, since; to, into, across and the rest

entries.en: The film starts [at|at / on / in] seven o’clock.
entries.note: Время на часах → at.

entries.en: The shop is closed [on|at / on / in] Mondays.
entries.note: Дни и даты → on: on Monday, on 5 May.

entries.en: My birthday is [in|at / on / in] July.
entries.note: Месяцы, годы, времена года → in.

entries.en: I can’t sleep [at|at / on / in] night.
entries.ru: Я не могу спать по ночам.
entries.note: at night, но in the morning / afternoon / evening.

entries.en: I usually run [in|at / on / in] the morning.
entries.note: in the morning / in the evening.

entries.en: Let’s meet [on|at / on / in] Friday evening.
entries.note: Конкретный день + часть дня → on.

entries.en: What are you doing [at|at / on / in] the weekend?
entries.note: at the weekend (брит.), on the weekend (амер.).

choice: I’ll see you on next week.
entries.note: Перед next, last, this, every предлог не нужен.

entries.en: The parcel will arrive [in|in / after] two days.
entries.note: Через (какое-то время от сейчас) → in.

entries.en: The train left exactly [on|in / on] time.
entries.note: on time — вовремя, по расписанию; in time — успеть заранее.

entries.en: We got to the cinema just [in|in / on] time to buy popcorn.
entries.ru: Мы пришли в кино как раз вовремя, чтобы купить попкорн.
entries.note: in time — успеть до чего-то.

entries.en: Turn left [at|at / in] the end of the street.
entries.note: at the end of — в конце чего-то; in the end — в итоге.

entries.en: I’ll be [at|at / in] home all evening.
entries.note: at home, at work, at school, at university.

entries.en: Mum’s [in|at / in] the kitchen.
entries.note: Внутри помещения → in.

entries.en: There’s a clock [on|in / on] the wall.
entries.note: На поверхности → on.

entries.en: I met her [on|in / on] the bus.
entries.note: on a bus / train / plane, но in a car / taxi.

entries.en: We went to the airport [in|in / on] a taxi.
entries.ru: Мы поехали в аэропорт на такси.
entries.note: in a car / taxi.

entries.en: We went there [by|by / on] car.
entries.note: by car / bus / train — без артикля; но on foot.

entries.en: It’s only ten minutes [on|by / on] foot.
entries.note: on foot — пешком.

entries.en: We arrived [in|in / at / to] Rome late at night.
entries.ru: Мы прилетели в Рим поздно ночью.
entries.note: arrive in + город, страна; arrive at + здание, аэропорт. Никогда arrive to.

entries.en: We arrived [at|in / at / to] the hotel at midnight.
entries.ru: Мы приехали в гостиницу в полночь.
entries.note: arrive at + конкретное место.
go home, get home — без to.

entries.en: She ran [into|into / in] the room and shut the door.
entries.ru: Она вбежала в комнату и закрыла дверь.
entries.note: Движение внутрь → into.

entries.en: Be careful when you walk [across|across / through] the road.
entries.note: across — поперёк, с одной стороны на другую.

entries.en: We walked [through|across / through] the forest.
entries.note: through — сквозь, внутри чего-то объёмного.

entries.en: The bank is [opposite|opposite / in front of] the post office, on the other side of the street.
entries.ru: Банк напротив почты, на другой стороне улицы.
entries.note: opposite — напротив (лицом друг к другу через улицу).

entries.en: The village lies [between|between / among] two lakes.
entries.note: between — между двумя (или отдельными) предметами; among — среди группы.

entries.en: I haven’t eaten [since|for / since] breakfast.
entries.note: since + момент.

entries.en: It rained [for|for / during] three days.
entries.note: for — как долго; during — когда (во время чего).

entries.en: He started school [at|at / in / with] the age of six.
entries.ru: Он пошёл в школу в шесть лет.
entries.note: at the age of…
